name: Face-in-Hexahedron Containment Test
definition: Determines if a triangle face is contained within a voxel's bounding box (hexahedron) by checking plane overlap and multiple separating axes.
summary: The Face-in-Hexahedron Containment Test determines if a triangle is fully inside a voxel by verifying plane overlap and separation along multiple axes, distinguishing itself from broader intersection tests.
